name: How long does it take to construct a custom seating wall?
description: Construction time varies from 1-2 weeks for simple walls to 3-4+ weeks for complex designs, depending on size, materials, and features.

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to construct a custom seating wall?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for constructing a custom seating wall varies based on its size, complexity, and the materials chosen. A small, straightforward wall might take 1-2 weeks from start to finish. More elaborate designs involving complex curves, integrated lighting, or multiple material types could extend to 3-4 weeks or more. This includes design finalization, material procurement, site preparation, construction, and finishing touches. We provide a detailed project schedule after the design phase.
